title: Most drivers fail this steering quiz.
hook: Most drivers fail this steering quiz.

script.narration: Most drivers fail this steering quiz. Should your thumbs be wrapped inside or resting outside the steering wheel rim?
script.visual_search: driver hands on steering wheel close up

script.narration: Take a second to think. Most people grab the wheel tightly with thumbs tucked in.
The correct answer is resting outside. If the airbag deploys while your thumbs are inside the rim, the force can break your thumbs instantly.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you get this answer right? Comment yes or no, because
script.visual_search: driver hands on wheel at 9 and 3 position

description: Are you holding your steering wheel safely? Test your knowledge with this quick driving quiz about proper hand positioning and airbag safety. Simple, potentially life-saving advice for every driver.
why_it_will_work: Uses a quiz format to engage viewers, which is a proven high-retention strategy on the channel, paired with a common but often ignored safety fact.
